column1: # Top-level scope. Layers applied in order; first match wins.
#   include <pattern>              host is in scope, actively probed
#   exclude <pattern>              host is out of scope, never touched
#   skip    <pattern>              host is in scope, resolved, but not probed
#   rate    <pattern>  <number>    per-host req/s cap (falls back to DEFAULT_RATE=20)
#   header  <pattern>  <Name: V>   extra header sent on every request to matching hosts
#   tag     <pattern>  <name>      metadata label, appears in exports only
# Patterns: hostname globs. `*.example.com` matches any subdomain.
# Include rules can reference other files:  include     ./path/to/file.tsv
# ---- Defaults (safe to keep on for every program) ----
